accuracy_target: Mean regret over the declared query prefix relative to each true full scalar-action interval optimum for the exact stored finite law.
cache_rights: Stored innovations may be reused; new postdecision arguments require valid reevaluation. All methods receive identical economic primitives.
certificate: Outward derivative residual plus uniform strong-concavity lower bound, with fully enumerated finite law; no statistical error allocation is required for this deterministic certificate.
chronology: This descriptive design file reconstructs the unchanged, already-frozen executable design. It does not replace or backdate the original DESIGN.json digest d49de13b68dda2ec2f7251dbf631e62247fe4b733f0e5fefb192a3f9b4e8284c.
costs: Separate real service for every method/dimension/volume/stream; task initialization, fitting/cache, every query, failed check and durable stage write included; startup charged once to full comparison; post-stop diagnostics separate.
current_task: Utility weight uniform[0.8,1.2], adjustment uniform[0.05,0.15], resource charge uniform[0,0.12], cap uniform[0.65,0.95]; feasible uniform withdrawal [0.05,cap].
finite_law: Four periods of length 0.25; sixteen stored paths of equal probability; all coefficients and increments are exact binary64 model primitives.
origin: Exact replay of the execution modules and finite economic inputs frozen at 6171912994009ee56520bc7e294a1960083f71c7; not new independent streams.
risk: Common exogenous lower/mid/upper actions and own selected actions; independent fitting/cache streams; full finite-law means; descriptive finite-design risks, not population confidence intervals.
stopping: First mean outward scalar-interval regret upper bound <= tolerance; otherwise unresolved at final stage; execution failures retained.
study: Temporary withdrawal charges in the inherited nonlinear capital economy
task_seed: 195520 + dimension; all task sets are prefixes of one 1024-row draw per dimension
